description: Update site settings: title, keyConvention, editingMode, signature ("Made with dotsy" badge), trailingSlash, ownSeoFiles, aiTrain, agentSearch, acceptIssues, the language settings, and cookieBanner (draft until publish; get_site shows it). Each field says when it applies. Slug is the hostname — use rename_site.

acceptIssues.description: true keeps the remaining SEO/page-health warnings; false undoes. Needs verify_page first; ask first.

aiTrain.description: false asks AI trainers to skip the site (default true). Live now.

cookieBanner.description: Send only what changes; null resets a field. Relay `issues` as written; Reject stays a full same-size button.

css.description: Banner CSS (the template's style block); null clears.

holds.description: {trackerId or host:x.com: statistics|marketing|run}; run = don't hold; null removes.

look.description: {accent, accentText, text, bg, link (#hex or rgb()), font, radius e.g. 8px}.

mode.description: smart asks in the EEA, UK, CH, Québec, unknown country and GPC, elsewhere a notice that sets the cookie and offers Opt out; always asks everyone; off = your own cookie tool.

template.description: reset = restart from design; default = drop custom template.

text.description: {headline ≤60, body ≤240 (must name dotsy, the host that sets the cookie), accept, reject, optOut ≤24}.

decline.description: siteState.next.step ids the person declined; all = no more suggestions.

defaultLanguage.description: Main language, e.g. "en". null removes every language setting. At publish.

editingMode.description: live (default): each editor save publishes. staged: drafts wait for publish_site.

formWords.description: Form words by language: {ja:{sending,error,success}}. Merged; null removes.

hreflang.description: auto (default) links translations for search engines; off stops. At publish.

languages.description: The OTHER languages (not the main one); replaces the list. Needs a main language. At publish.

publish.description: false hides it from links and the switcher; pages still serve.

ownSeoFiles.description: Use the site's own robots.txt even if it blocks everything, and its sitemap.xml. At publish.

signature.description: "Made with dotsy" badge (defaults: mark dot, reveal seal, side right). Live at once.

enabled.description: Show the badge on published pages.

reveal.description: seal: stamp on hover; pill: label on hover; eye: always open.

trailingSlash.description: ignore (default) serves /blog and /blog/; never 301s /blog/ to /blog; always the reverse. Live at once.

name: update_site
